Messages.Author: inr...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
> hi again, 2 questions:
> 1. When a vampire rescue another from torpor, can she pass some blood
> counters to the one that it's beeing rescued?

Nope, and if untaped the rescued vampire must hunt, hence the evilness
of a haven uncovered on a vamp in torpor with no blood.

> 2. When you intercept a vampire that it's rescuing herself from
torpor,
> it is obligate to diablerize her?

No, you have the option to diablerize, but if you can't swing the
votes, you can just block the action... but hey whats igo good for
anyway (that would be a neat flaw, must diablerize if possiable, after
all he is hungry)

Cameron
